```{r}
#| label: load-libraries

library(arrow)
library(readxl)

```

```{r}
#| label: load-functions

load_parquet <- function(filename, path) {
  assign(filename, read_parquet(path), .GlobalEnv)
}

load_excel <- function(dataset, filenames, paths) {
  l <- pmap(list(filenames, paths), \(file, p) read_excel(p))
  assign(dataset, l, .GlobalEnv)
}

```

```{r}
#| label: load

pwalk(select(parquets, -dataset), load_parquet)
```
